name: Maine Wood Heat Company
old_description: Three generations of craftsmanship evolved into three brands to better serve our diverse range of customers.
about:
Maine Wood Heat Company operates from Skowhegan, Maine, where Albie and Cheryl (Kemper) Barden founded the business in the late 1970s. What began as a family venture centered on Finnish-style masonry heaters has grown into a multi-brand operation still owned and run by the Barden family. Second-generation co-owner Scott Barden joined full-time in 2005, shifting the model from nomadic installations to in-house artisan manufacturing under one roof.

The company now works through three complementary brands. Maine Oven Craft produces handcrafted wood-fired ovens for residential backyards and commercial kitchens, including pizzerias and fine-dining restaurants. Maine Metalcraft provides metal fabrication, custom design, and low-volume manufacturing, drawing on more than 75 years of collective expertise among its craftsmen. The Masonry Heaters brand delivers site-built brickwork, stone masonry, and fireplace installation for whole-home heating.

Customers range from homeowners seeking a masonry heater as a primary heat source to chefs and restaurateurs who need high-volume wood-fired ovens. The metal fabrication shop serves clients requiring custom-designed parts and short-run production. All work is performed by a small team of builders, designers, welders, and problem-solvers rather than an automated factory line.

The founders frame the business around enduring values of craftsmanship, connection, and respect for natural materials. They emphasize that they are not a factory but a family of artisans, a distinction they say drives the care put into each oven, heater, and fabricated component.
